# Independent formal review: select MAIN 59-use proposal v1

**Conclusion:** no material blocker found for the bounded 59-use source-evidence proposal, provided integration merges by exact triple and preserves concurrent changes. This is review of the frozen candidate, not a canonical admission, full runtime or security verdict. The separately reviewed new `signal` use is outside these frozen 59 and is not admitted by this patch.

Manifest SHA-256 `6265b8de6748c587aa8ce43b945c889b3a1398e07d277b4eb78e0a79f8fb1d55`; combined patch `f85582e734c14b6ae45c6aa0da306371635c39c2069a0f4061597bc389894aee`. All listed patch, checker, manifest-member and triple bytes independently hash-match. Source is `select-base.ts` SHA-256 `120ab123d79e58ea256211cafa50268dba3ce26524426e88b0347a8624aee68d`; the prior source is `901810bb9f5b187c261d3d3268343dc85a2f1b0dbfdad0a6a9dba6a33e6deb91`. Earlier substantive per-use/peer/identity review is `review-v1.md` SHA-256 `56cbf1653cc66f92fdbe6436083ee7346e98289dac79184b851911d64c8afdc3` in this directory.

## Complete-record preservation

Independently compared the full candidate to the frozen ledger at `38e1ed8d076d4b45727f4feab7270c873f3adf68`: all 1,736 ordered file/module/symbol triples and root metadata match. Exactly 59 select-base entries differ and all 1,677 other complete entries are unchanged. Each changed entry changes its `source_review` and appends one history entry naming the former review; removing that appended entry and restoring the old reference reproduces its entire old row. Each new individual review embeds the entire exact prior ledger row and complete prior matching review, including historic decision and evidence, and retains the old conclusion. All 59 candidate occurrence lists, declaration records and prior evidence-status sets equal the separately reviewed draft. Six import-only uses, local coercion type unions, and distinct owned viewport and form-field identities remain accurately described in that source review.

The previous `ViewportRuler` record identifies the old `scripts/packed-consumer-aot-smoke.mjs` hash `73facfb8f10d796822be68779b0e90fadac04f539c028a0dc1ffbce260af11f5`; its current hash is `01902ab394480c2c50ef11ea953ab49a1f0d4cf65484661b76688ff418074733`. The prior full review and the explicit mismatched evidence status remain embedded. The new checker-facing evidence references the preserved old review and the new capsule/probe, rather than asserting the stale old producer hash still matches. The capsule separately records the narrowly inspected one-field producer diff and the current artifact replay. The old evidence is historical context; it is not silently refreshed or an independently current producer identity.

## Capsule and actual observations

Capsule SHA-256 `2159f0f2d08009aedb836ff6ceacde8e33df7f5d92facc29af28f6d0da0b46af`; probe snapshot SHA-256 `75f8ba753296bd8b6994577629d47790699e1fb72786512e6915d8e517f7c456`. The snapshot text occurs in the retained native fixture. Independently checked that the capsule's selected packed-consumer case objects equal the raw report cases, its positive and negative focused case records equal their raw reports, its totals match, and the negative failure details match. The capsule accurately binds the copied clean 8baa pack artifact `de6ffdb22268d884037f4661bf8972dc04531cbf0a5eb97f008728e57c54a840`, whose select source matches the reviewed 6cce file. It distinguishes the actual 106/106 JSDOM packed-consumer producer replay from selected native Chrome149 293/293 and from the one-file plain-boolean extracted-package mutant 290/293. The mutant is not a packed or tagged baseline.

The focused test uses a zoneless provider and fixture auto detection, checks the actual option ripple directives after public boolean/string/null input transitions without manual detection, and its same-fixture mutant fails the targeted ripple assertions. Zone.js remains loaded, and the selected registry does not prove historical inventory completeness. The capsule and proposal correctly preserve those limitations and do not claim Zone.js-free bootstrap, comprehensive browser/floor/SSR behavior, or release qualification. Raw logs/reports and artifact are outside the patch in the retained external evidence directory; the included capsule and probe are scoped snapshots, not a self-contained runtime replay.

## Direct checker and trust limit

Ran an independent pinned-Node direct call to the existing `authoredUseReviewEvidence` implementation, using the 38e baseline and isolated candidate. It reproduces 307 → 248 insufficient, precisely the intended 59 triples removed, none added. Five controls separately reopen all 59 when the line, source, review, capsule or probe is wrong. A deliberately false review decision with the mutable roster's review hash recomputed still leaves zero of those 59 insufficient: the existing generic checker validates references and shape, not semantic truth or immutable authorship. Results and script are `direct-admission-v1.json` and `direct-admission-v1.mjs` alongside this report. The independent human/agent source review substantiates the actual frozen text only; it is not a signed authority or a semantic forgery detector.

The evidence-only patch passes `git apply --check` on 38e; the complete ledger patch is a transport proposal, not a safe replacement for concurrent roster work. No shared checker or current-roster change is proposed, no additional native run was performed in this review, and no 21.x, G11, security or release pass is implied.
